title: Confidence of satellite-predicted depth (SWOT ML model)
units: predicted depth error (file gives no unit; class thresholds 80 / 150 are consistent with metres)
description: Where the seafloor depth is predicted from SWOT satellite gravity rather than measured, how confident the prediction is: high (predicted error < 80), medium (80–150), low (> 150). Cells containing a ship sounding and land are transparent. Confidence of the authors' SWOT machine-learning bathymetry, which is related to but not the same grid as GEBCO_2026.
transparent: class 0 (contains a sounding), class 4 (land), beyond 80 deg
lowerZooms: pixels are the mean predicted_error of the non-sounding cells underneath, then classed
citation: Nilsson, B., Phrampus, B. J., Salajegheh, F., Liu, B., Yu, Y., Sandwell, D., Harper, H., Andersen, O. B., Smith, W. H. F., Elmore, P., Kirby, J., Beale, J., Roberts, J. & Altamirano, L. (2025) Bathymetry Prediction with SWOT Gravity Anomaly using Machine Learning Methods: Paper 2 - Model Evaluation and Uncertainty Analysis [Bathymetry_Prediction_Confidence_Level_v1.1].
